item.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week
item.description: Pope Leo XIV said he would undergo surgery after doctors found a "localized nodule" in his lung.

item.title: Hurricane Simon nears Mexico with 155 mph winds and flooding fears
item.description: The eye of Hurricane Simon was just off the Pacific coast of Mexico early Sunday and was expected to move inland later in the day as an extremely powerful storm.

item.title: Don't be scared: Being afraid is outright fun, and maybe useful
item.description: Listeners of NPR's Weekend Edition Sunday may already know that host Ayesha Rascoe loves horror. But why do scream queens (and kings) like her like what's frightening? The answer may surprise you.

item.title: She was a global star: Teen bikes 700 miles carrying injured dad. Where is she now?
item.description: Her epic ride — carrying her injured dad on her $20 hot pink bicycle — made headlines. Promises were made — financial help, training for a cycling career, even a movie deal. Were any of them kept?

item.title: Sweating the details: Sauna's potential health benefits draw scientists' interest
item.description: A group of international researchers is pushing to rigorously study the potential health benefits of sauna and other heat therapies. They hope to bring scientific legitimacy to the age-old practices.

item.title: Reshaped civil rights mission at Justice Department transforms its work, workforce
item.description: Harmeet Dhillon has pushed out hundreds of longtime attorneys, replaced many with inexperienced ideological allies, and used the division's enforcement powers to pursue the president's agenda.

item.title: It's taking longer to find a new job after losing one
item.description: People who lose their jobs in this economy are taking longer to find new work. Nearly four in ten people exhaust their unemployment benefits before they land a new job.

item.title: Passenger terminal at Riyadh airport is struck again, a day after 12 were killed
item.description: A projectile struck a passenger terminal at the international airport in Riyadh on Sunday, a day after a missile hit the same terminal and killed 12 people, officials said.
